subject.title: ci: migrate releases to unified pipeline

question: Should this repository adopt the shared `release-go-cli.yml@v1` workflow as the authoritative release path, including its write permissions and signing-secret contract, before the old tag-triggered path is disabled?
rationale: This is a release-process and trust-boundary decision: source inspection can show the handoff, but cannot establish that repository owners accept the centralized workflow contract and operational fallback model.

options.title: Validate and adopt the unified path
options.body: Have a release-workflow owner verify the shared workflow contract and a controlled release/snapshot handoff, then merge the migration.

options.title: Keep the legacy trigger for now
options.body: Retain the existing tag-triggered release path until the shared workflow has been approved and exercised for this repository.

recommendation.title: Validate and adopt the unified path
recommendation.body: Have a release-workflow owner verify the shared workflow contract and a controlled release/snapshot handoff, then merge the migration.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the collaborator who proposed the release migration and is the clearest available routing contact in the supplied PR history.
